Mirror Group is a group of isles on West Metropolis Archipelago (C). However, in terms of district, it is located in Sava West Shoal. It is also home to one of the three islands in West Metropolis Archipelago which belongs to Sava District. Despite being named as a Group, it is a "pseudo-archipelago" made up of a plateau, a lagoon and a shoal. Currently, Route 3 passes through this group and sets up support pillars in here, but no development was seen in here otherwise.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is built above the tracks of Delta Line, and as Delta Line was already at Y=24, there is sufficient room for a station to be built at this location without relocating the Delta Line tracks.[2]
  • Similar to Lei Tiu Lau Station, this station is also a "Pioneering" Station, as the station arrives before the development commences around this area.
  • The Name of this station is similar to the word "Money", and is designed with the concept of riches in mind.[3]

History[]

  • October 13 2022: This station completed construction.[4]

Location[]

Mopen Isle is located to the northwest of Star Island, and is a subsidiary isle of it.

Transport[]

Railway[]

While Star Island Light Rail does not have a station on this isle, it can still be accessed through taking Star Island Light Rail to Mopen Isle Entrance Station.

Roads[]

This isle features a walkway that circumnavigates the isle, and is also connected to Star Island using the Mopen Isle Entrance.

Mosaic Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago (North). After three years of development, this island completed development on April 2021.

This island is the third island to feature two Nazca Railway Stations on a single island after Airship Island and Perquel Island, with the two stations on Mosaic Island being Mosaic Island Station and Mosaic North Station. However, Nazca Railway does not recommend interchanging between the two stations.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Platform Pillars of this station alludes to Mosaic Island Station.
  • The Yellow and Black color scheme alludes to Pikachu, the favourite Pokémon of the Mosaic Island owner.[4]
  • This station is the first station to be built with SignPicture Signs upon construction.
  • A diagonal staircase is featured at Exit A of this station.
  • A short-range teleporter similar to that at Mount Egress Station is featured at Exit B of this station as the exits are built at longer distances from the concourse as per the request of the Mosaic Island owner.

History[]

  • March 29 2020: Plans are in place to build this station.[5]
  • April 14 2020: This Station is under construction.[6]
  • April 15 2020: This Station began services.
  • August 27 2020: This station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[7]
  • July 19 2021: This station completed exit naming.[8]

Fun Facts[]

  • The Word "Delrow" of this Station is an Anagram of the Word Game Wordle, and this fact is also reflected in the Livery and Building Materials used in this Station. In that game, Light Gray indicates that the letter guessed is not in the word, whereas yellow and green indicates wrong positioning of the correct letter, and the correct positioning of the correct letter respectively. This Station also makes use of Light Gray, Yellow and Green Concrete to reflect this fact.
  • Posters and Decorations depicting various English Words exists throughout the structure of this station, as well as outside the Station.
  • The platforms of this Station is located directly beneath Mount Delrow, and the Exits of this Station are extended in various directions out of the mountain range as a result. Hence, the Platform and Concourse Levels are denoted as Upper Ground and Lower Ground Levels despite the entire station being located under the mountain.

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this station takes reference from Hittites, Anatolian Peoples who mainly resided in West Asia. As a result, this station adopts building materials that have a more ancient feel to it. As per the request of the Peckern North developer, this station uses terracotta and chiseled sandstone taking references to Sung Wong Toi.[2]
  • The Entrance to the Station Control Room is not placed at the concourse. Instead, it is placed at the platform level.

History[]

  • July 19 2021: This station began services.
  • August 20 2021: This station completed exit naming.[3]

Operations[]

Railways[]

  • Samui Line: A line handed over from Frosview Railway that was built in Period 6 of the Co-Op Railway.
  • Northward Line: A line built in the Continuous Development Phase of the Co-Op Railway. It runs between Scarlet Spring and Magnolia Hill.

Light Railways[]

  • Three Line Island Light Rail: A light rail system built in Three Line Island that is handed over to Mushroom Transit.
  • Dark Pearl Transit System: A light rail system built by Frosview Railway.
    • Pearl Ring Line: A line in Dark Pearl Transit System. Handed over to Mushroom Transit.

Myosotis Valley Station is a station on Akashi Line and Daybreaker Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas TriPaw. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 1511, Line 1514 (Myosotis Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • The Color scheme of this station alludes to Koishi Komeiji, a character from Touhou Project. As Koishi Komeiji is the sister of Satori Komeiji, the character who Old Brightland and Old Brightland Station are based on, this station is also the sister station of Old Brightland Station .
  • The green color of this station also alludes to the plant of the Same Name.[2]

History[]

  • August 12 2020: This Station began services. Akashi Line, Daybreaker Line are established.

title: N-Stock
safeHtml:
The N-stock is a train designed by "New Horizons Technology" (The parent company of Nazca Railway) designed for Standard Railway use.

Contents

  • 1 Technical Information
    • 1.1 Exterior and Outlook
    • 1.2 Variants
    • 1.3 Specifications
    • 1.4 Power Systems
  • 2 Vehicle Design
    • 2.1 Seats
    • 2.2 Train Interior
    • 2.3 Passenger Information Display System
    • 2.4 Car Doors
    • 2.5 Neutral Zone
  • 3 Application
  • 4 Related Trains
  • 5 Citations and References

Technical Information[]

Exterior and Outlook[]

  • Driver Cab Car Length: 25000 mm
  • Normal Car Length: 22000 mm
  • Width: 3000 mm
  • Height: 3750 mm
  • Total Length (9-Carriage): 204000 mm (204 m)
  • Track Gauge: 1432 mm
  • Car Doors: 5 doors on both sides
  • Material: Titanium Alloy
  • Destination Indication: Full-Color LED, alternating between Route Name and Destination Name.

Variants[]

Code: D－Driver Cab, H－Control Car, M－Motor, P－Pantograph, T－Trailer

  • 4-Carriage: 2M2T(D-P-M-D)

D41xx - P42xx - M43xx - D44xx

  • 6-Carriage: 4M2T(D-P-M-M-P-D)

D61xx - P62xx - M63xx - M64xx - P65xx - D66xx

  • 9-Carriage: 5M4T(D-P-M-H-M-T(H)-M-P-D)

D91xx - P92xx - M93xx - H94xx - M95xx - H96xx或T96xx[1] - M97xx - P98xx - D99xx

After the 100th Rolling Stock:
D91xxx - P92xxx - M93xxx - H94xxx - M95xxx - H96xxx - M97xxx - P98xxx - D99xxx

xx and xxx represents the order of rolling stock constructed.

Specifications[]

  • Designed Maximum Speed: 135 km/h
  • Operational Maximum Speed (Los Sengas): 125 km/h
  • Acceleration: 4.5 km/h/s
  • Deceleration: 2-5 km/h/s

Power Systems[]

  • Electrification: 1500 V DC (Can be customized for support of 25000V 60Hz AC and alternation between AC and DC).
  • Current Collector: Wireless Pantograph
  • Braking system: Regenerative Braking blended with air brake.

Vehicle Design[]

Seats[]

All trains have vertical seats, some have headrests and artificial leather.

Train Interior[]

Circular Plastic Rings and cylindrical handrails are set up between train doors, with an improved holding position for optimized touch. While there was formerly a hand rail in the middle of the car doors, as it affects the efficiency of passenger flow, they were later removed. To the left of every third door of each carriage, wheelchair space is available. Each carriage can place up to two wheelchairs. Standing Room is also placed at the third and seventh carriage, and seats are NOT available between the second door and the third door.

Passenger Information Display System[]

A 17.5-inch LCD screen is placed on the car door to play advertisements and news information, and two connected 17.5-inch display screens display train information, including the next station, the destination, the station layout and transfer information. In total, there are three 17.5-inch displays on the car door.

Car Doors[]

Car doors are 1500mm wide, and all car doors are electrically operated. While the doors are quiet during operation, a sound indicatior will also sound when the doors are about to close to ensure passenger safety.

Neutral Zone[]

When trains pass through Neutral Zones, the Electrical Voltage becomes Zero, and a loud bang will be heard due to air pressure. However, they only exist in The Shuttle, and other areas are separated using insulators. Signs also exist to indicate the beginning and end of Neutral Zones.

Application[]

  • All Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division) Lines
  • 4-Carriage Variant: Sava Line
  • 6-Carriage Variant: Expo Line, Interisland Line, Gondola Line
  • 9-Carriage Variant: West Ring Line, East Ring Line, Urban Line, Urban Express, New Edward Line, Stadium Line, Xofa Line, Arcgo Line, Avgto Line, Luxter Line, Swift Line, Flask Line, Kinight Line, Daring Line, Zephyr Line, Sparkling Line, Origin Line, Minecraft Line, Ingress Line, Glacier Line, Glacier Express, Oasis Bay Line, Abyss Line, Egress Line, Stadow Line, Cometsilk Line, Glinstrouß Line, Prospektious Line, Snowty Line, Pegasus Line, Phoenix Line, Akashi Line, Daybreaker Line, Vision Line, Wanderer Line, Everchord Line

(Also used by Alpha Line, Bravo Line, Charlie Line, Delta Line, Epsilon Line, Fox Line, Golf Line, Kilo Line, Lima Line, Mike Line during rush hours and for spare purposes). While this rolling stock would also be used by Veloducts during rush hours to alleviate passengers due to its larger passenger capacity, as the number of seats is also lower in this train, this rolling stock is avoided by veloducts at non-rush hours.

Standard Railway and Veloduct trains support up to nine carriages, whereas Sub-Standard Railways support up to six carriages.

Related Trains[]

  • V-Stock: The Veloduct Variant of this rolling stock.

Citations and References[]

  1. Project Nazca CC - 納斯卡計劃 閒聊－【納斯卡鐵路 NR】【模擬台】
  2. 香港 Minecraft 鐵路聯盟－【納斯卡鐵路及通用鐵路公司】聯合列車採購通知
  1. ↑ Only the Sample Car is a T Variant (T9601), other stocks is H Variant.

Nail Bight Checkpoint is a checkpoint on New Edward Line, Cometsilk Line, Phoenix Line, Starshore Line, Delta Line and Kilo Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Cometsilk. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 1701, Line 2611 (NR Nail Bight Checkpoint Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • As this station is the 204th Station, and Standard Railway Platforms are 204m long, a wall of signs highlighting the first 204 Stations of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division is seen at the east wall above the Kilo Line Platforms.
  • The Red color scheme of this station alludes to Rusty Metal as nails in Public Toilets in Hong Kong are usually rusted.[2]
  • When viewed from the top, the shape of the pool at the Station Park resembles a nail, and the support pillars of this station also alludes to a nail.
  • The Floor Height of this station initially (from Delta Line Platforms to New Edward Line Platforms) is 40m tall, and is further expanded to 45m (between Phoenix Line and New Edward Line Platforms) after the expansion in S3E18.
  • After the Starshore Line Expansion of this Station, the Los Sengas Coffee is relocated to the East Concourse of this Station. This expansion also caused this Checkpoint to become the second Checkpoint to serve six lines after Sand Martin Checkpoint, meaning that this Station, alongside Sand Martin, shares the record for serving the most railway lines when Metropolis Terminal is not considered.
  • Due to Geological Constraints, Delta Line is the only line that can directly interchange with Starshore Line, and East Concourse, which connects with the aforementioned platforms, only features passageways connecting to the Main Concourse, the Phoenix Line, Delta Line and Kilo Line Platforms, with no direct access to New Edward Line and Cometsilk Line Platforms. Therefore, passengers need to make use of one of the following to access between Starshore Line Platforms or the East Concourse and the New Edward Line, Cometsilk Line Platforms:
    • Use the non-entry gate area passageway between the Main Concourse and the East Concourse near Exit E;
    • Pass through Phoenix Line and Delta Line Platforms (Applicable for New Edward Line Passengers), or;
    • Pass through Kilo Line Platforms (Applicable for Cometsilk Line Passengers).
    • Alternatively, passengers that need to change between Cometsilk Line and Starshore Line can also consider making the transfer at Welliant Plateau Station.

History[]

  • February 2 2018: This station began services alongside New Edward Line, but Cometsilk Line, Delta Line and Kilo Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • February 3 2018: Delta Line extends from Kelper Mount Station to this Station.
  • February 15 2018: Cometsilk Line is established.
  • February 19 2018: Kilo Line is established.
  • July 4 2021: This station completed exit naming, and Exit E is added to this station, connecting to Comet-star Boulevard.[3]
  • October 4 2022: This station completed expansion of the Phoenix Line section.[4]
  • October 5 2022: Phoenix Line extends from Warm Cairn Station to this station.
  • June 8 2024: Exit F is added to this station, connecting to New Nail Bight Bus Terminus.
  • December 1 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]
  • April 8 2026: The Station Cuisine of this station is added. At the same day, this Station began expansion of the Starshore Line Part.
  • April 11 2026: This station completed expansion of the Starshore Line Part, but as Starshore Line is not yet connected to another station, Platforms 11, 12 remain reserved.
  • April 26 2026: Starshore Line extends from this station to Welliant Plateau Station through Rougewood Station. Starshore Line is established.

Natbour Isle is one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is a subsidiary isle of Boundary Island.

Location[]

Natbour Isle is located to the southeast of Boundary Island and the south of Numpool Island.

Fun Facts[]

  • Southern Loop also had plans to set up a Station on this isle. However, due to historical reasons, while this station completed construction, the tracks to this station were never connected. Nevertheless, remnants of this station could be seen on this island.

title: Nawis Railway
safeHtml:
Nawis Railway, abbreviated as NAR, is one of the operators involved in the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. It took part in development in Periods 2, 4 and 5, as well as the Continuous Development Phase of the Co-Op Railway.

Operations[]

Railway[]

  • Peckern Main Line: A line built in Period 2 of the Co-Op Railway. It runs between West Plateau and Landing Pole.
  • Southern Corridor: A line built in Period 4 of the Co-Op Railway. It extended in Period 5 and the Continous Development Phase, and runs between Summer Point and Charm River.
  • Labyrinth Line: A line built in the Continuous Development Phase of the Co-Op Railway. It runs between Nagasora and Potato Farmland.
  • Snow White Line: A line built in the Continuous Development Phase of the Co-Op Railway. It runs between Europa or Potato Farmland and Parrot Mount.
  • Masquerade Line: A line built in the Continuous Development Phase of the Co-Op Railway. It runs between Sandy Heights or Blubird and Cityyard Shrine.

Nazca Railway (納斯卡鐵路 ; known as NR, NRC) is one of the one-person Minecraft railway systems in Hong Kong. Established on 17 November 2011, it operates free railway services on its servers. Apart from railway services, NR also branched out into public works, becoming an all-around transportation and large-scale construction provider.

Contents

  • 1 Divisions
  • 2 Management
  • 3 Brand Identification
    • 3.1 Corporate Colours
    • 3.2 Annual Slogan
  • 4 Service Philosophy
  • 5 By-laws
  • 6 Comments and Competition
  • 7 Images
  • 8 References and External Links

Divisions[]

NR has been developing in the following Minecraft worlds[1]:

  • Los Sengas Division: Developing, as the largest railway network. There are currently 62 lines, including 29 main lines, 10 branches (including East Ring Line, New Edward Line, Kinight Line, and Cometsilk Line branches), 1 express, 8 Veloducts, 9 Shuttles, and 5 Local Rapid Transits.
    • NR Buses
    • Sava Light Transit (Became a public-management railway system, no longer under NR)
  • Terracept Division: Ended, once the largest railway network. 12 lines in total before termination of development.
  • Nether Division: Ended, was the first division ever developed.
  • Golden Division: Ended.
  • Island Division: Cancelled, NR created its prototype of Platform Safety Doors there.
  • Heaven Pacific Division: Ended, was the first time when NR developed two divisions simultaneously.

Service Philosophy[]

By-laws[]

The Nazca Railway by-laws have set the rules and principles for using railway services. Offenders may be prosecuted by NR according to local rules. However, surrenders will be reduced or exempted from responsibility depending on the circumstances.

title: Nazca Railway (Heaven Pacific Division)
safeHtml:
Nazca Railway Heaven Pacific Division (納斯卡鐵路 (天荔分部)), was established on November 18 2017. While it existed, Nazca Railway had simultaneously developed this division alongside Los Sengas Division, and was the only instance of such a development mode in Nazca Railway to date. However, development of this division ended on July 20 2018 due to the release of Java Edition 1.13, and this division is no longer accessible.

Contents

  • 1 Differences with Los Sengas Division
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 Line List
  • 4 Gallery
  • 5 References and External Links

Differences with Los Sengas Division[]

  1. Episodes listed in a manner similar to Terracept Division (With no "Seasons" involved)
  2. Slightly simplified announcements
  3. The line is represented by the first English Letter of the English name of the line instead of a number
  4. All stations are assigned with a code
  5. Stations won't be graded (eg. No "terminal-class", "checkpoint-class", "gateway-class" stations)
  6. All exits are named
  7. Tunnel width increased from 5X5 to 7X7 including tunnel walls
  8. All tunnels equipped with overhead catenaries (for decoration purposes)
  9. At each end of the platform, a manual override control for platform gates are installed.

Fun Facts[]

  • Some features of this division have been adopted into the Los Sengas Division after improvements are made on it, such as the Nazca Railway Station Numbering and Directional System.

Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division (納斯卡鐵路 (洛聖加分部) ;Formerly named Metropolis Division), is established on March 15 2015. Development of this division begun on March 10 the same year, and is currently the largest Rail Transport Operator in Los Sengas. Rail networks under this flagship is scattered all across Los Sengas, and this division also assisted in multiple infrastructural projects, including but not limited to the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals and Mayler Airport.

Businesses[]

In Los Sengas, Nazca Railway is responsible for the construction and management of the following railway systems[1]:

  • Light Rail: Sava Light Transit (Formerly)
  • Regional Rail: Local Rapid Transit (LRT)
  • Medium-Capacity Rail Systems: Sub-Standard Railway
  • High-Capacity/Heavy Rail Systems: Standard Railway
  • Commuter Rail: Veloduct
  • Intercity Rail: Linker Railway (Proposed)
  • Airport Railway: Hub Railway (Proposed)
  • Personal Rapid Transit: The Shuttle

Sava Light Transit (SLT) System[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at SLT.

SLTs are also named "In-district" railways, and was operated by Sava Light Transit as a subsidiary in Los Sengas. While SLT used to be a part of Nazca Railway, it now opeartes independently.

Rolling Stocks[]

  • N-Stock: The Rolling Stock used for Standard Railways and occasionally Veloducts.
  • V-Stock: The Rolling Stock used exclusively by Veloducts.
  • H-Stock: The proposed Rolling Stock used for Hub Railways.
  • L-Tram: The Rolling Stock used by SLT, with a high undercarriage design.
  • Nick-train: The inspection train used by Nazca Railway. Also used for new routes for testing purposes.

Train Bases[]

Currently, Los Sengas Houses 7 completed depots and two depots under planning. Moreover, 10 stabling sidings and train yards are situated under Heeled Island, the south of Internal Sea East Station, beneath Spade Valley Station, to the east of Compahills Station, to the east of Pingsing Station, to the east of Vanilla Bay Station, to the south of Whitecliff Village Station, to the west of Intus Occident Gateway, to the south of Wisely Station and to the west of Odyssey Vista Station.

NR Premium Lounge[]

NR Premium Lounges are Lounges that are operated by Nazca Railway. Its concept is derived from Airport Lounges that are usually provided for VIP Passengers by different Airlines, but are free for use in the case of Nazca Railway. Incidents[]

Upper Rover Station Destruction Incident[]

On April 29 2017, due to misuse of commands from an administrator, Upper Rover Station was nearly completely destroyed. As a result, Nazca Railway conducted emergency repair works in accordance to backup blueprints. The station completed restoration the next day. This incident later became the inspiration for its Station Characteristic.

Glacier Station Destruction Incident[]

On July 7 2018 21:50 (UTC +8), due to misuse of commands from an administrator, Glacier Station was closed for over three hours, with Glacier Line, which only ran between the aforementioned station and Ingress Flatland Station at the time, being put out of service. Flask Line also terminated services at Spike End Station, and players also went to Glacier Station to assess damages until another administrator expelled the players from the site. 20 minutes after the accident, Nazca Railway has announced the destructuion of Glacier Station on a public notice. The station completed restoration on 1am the next day, and the administrator involved issued a letter of apology for this incident.

title: Nazca Railway 2020+ Plans
safeHtml:
The Nazca Railway 2020+ Plans is a Development Plan proposed by Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division starting from 2020 and is announced on January 9 of the Same Year.

Contents

  • 1 Development Plan Link
  • 2 Original Text (In Chinese)
  • 3 English Translation of Full Text
  • 4 Current Progress
  • 5 Gallery
  • 6 References and External Links

Development Plan Link[]

  • https://www.facebook.com/nazcarailway/posts/2610518932401146

Original Text (In Chinese)[]

洛聖加納鐵 Los Sengas NR

仲記唔記得納鐵喺上年年尾嘅時候會公佈「納鐵 2020+ 計劃」？而家正式計劃出爐喇，而呢個計劃係淨係針對洛聖加納鐵，而未必一定喺 2020 年內完成，如果納鐵會去其他地方就會另行通知。

如果 tl;dr 嘅話可以睇下圖雞精版㗎。

1. 大都會總站地下行人隧道及第六至九期擴建。

1a. 地下行人隧道：

現時大都會總站有 4 個行人隧道區域，納鐵計劃喺紅場同大都會之間嘅區域、都河站以東同都泉站東南嘅區域建立 3 個新嘅總站行人隧道。

1b. 第六至九期擴建：

喺現有嘅第四期結構中預留嘅「樞紐鐵路白羊綫」月台將會撥入第四期嘅主要結構，並且改由一條新嘅速管鐵路代行。

跟著喺第四期同層嘅北面會喺未來擴建第六至七期：第六期將會有一個全新嘅大堂同一組側式月台，俾未來樞紐鐵路白羊綫之用，咁樣大堂可以加入更多同樞紐鐵路有關嘅設施同方便控制人流；第七期會喺第六期嘅北面，會另建四組島式月台俾未來 2 條新嘅標準鐵路綫途經。

第八同九期會喺地面：第八期喺地面大堂嘅北面嘅路軌交匯處之上，將會興建全新嘅巴士總站同多層停車場，巴士總站預計會預留多於一百條巴士綫途徑，納鐵亦會承建同改善附近嘅道路網迎合未來流量；第九期喺第八期北面，派比安路之上嘅高架結構，俾未來嘅區內鐵路系統用 (第 3 項)。

2. 總部第一階段：站體及車廠

納鐵嘅總部經過多年嘅準備終於有具體嘅文字規劃，為方便發展同搵緊急替代方案，總部嘅建設會分段形式建造。總部位置落實喺「優托管制區及極光群島」建造，大體上嘅設計會以「亞特蘭蒂斯神話」作為主調，會有多個人工島作唔同用途。

第一階段係「優托站 Centopia Station」及納鐵總車廠，會係獨立一個南北藥丸型人工島嶼，初部估計長大約 3 公里；車站會先落成高架部分，即 10 號盜鈴綫同地區捷運同大堂部分；亦會建造車廠同車輛通道。

3. 成立區內鐵路系統

繼標準同次標準鐵路之後，納鐵再成立新嘅鐵路模式：區內鐵路系統。解釋：如果當標準鐵路係一分之一嘅鐵路嘅話，納鐵嘅次標準鐵路係四分之三個標準鐵路嘅規模，區內鐵路嘅設定會係標準鐵路嘅二分之一，未至於輕型鐵路(納鐵視為四分之一)。

而同次標準唔同嘅地方係，區內鐵路系統係同(次)標準分開，一個區域由一至幾條區內路綫所組成，編號為「英文字母」帶「數字」，例如「A1 號綫」，唔會有獨立名稱，而英文字母就係分區系統編號，綫號唔會獨立存在 (速管使用獨英文字母)，納鐵現正規劃市中心、尖岸同優托嘅系統。

4. 正式車站介紹影片

除咗每集完結嘅介紹同行車影片之外，小編想以一個比較認真嘅態度介紹每個納鐵嘅車站，除咗大都會總站會分開拍之外，小編應該會順著落成次序拍，亦會分季集，按車站初落成時所在集數同季數而定。

5. 標準及速管鐵路全面使用車站號碼及方向系統

呢個都唔特別需要多講不過都要寫低，自從納鐵喺第三季第七集之後就陸續為現有車站更新指示牌，因為納鐵對於車站號碼嘅研究已經成熟，搵到一個度身訂造嘅號碼系統，呢個系統除咗號碼之外都有分上下行嘅標記，俾乘客更方便知道自己喺上行站定下行站，往上行定下行都能夠一目了然。

6. 納鐵宋收錄至 1 萬字

呢個係一個好長遠嘅目標，而家有 4 千鬆啲字，未來幾年小編會為納鐵獨有嘅字型擴充字庫，雖然實際用途唔大，不過都係為興趣啫。

English Translation of Full Text[]

Los Sengas NR

Do you still remember the time when NR says that the "Nazca Railway 2020+ Plans" will be announced? Now, the plans are officially out. This plan only focuses on Los Sengas NR, and does not necessarily have to be completed in 2020.

tl;dr? Look at the concentrated version below.

1. Metropolis Terminal and Underground Walkway expansion:

1a. Underground Walkway expansion:

Currently, there are four zones in the Metropolis Terminal Underground Walkway. Nazca Railway plans to construct three additional Underground Walkways, one between Red Stadium and Metropolis, one to the east of Metro River Station, and one to the southeast of Metro Spring Station.

1b. Phases VI to IX:

The existing reserved platforms for the Hub Railway ARIES Line will be distributed to the current Phase IV Structure and handed over to a New Veloduct.

Phases VI and VII will be constructed directly to the north of Phase IV. Phase VI will feature an entirely new set of side paltforms and a new concourses for the future ARIES Line. This way, the new concourse can insert new Hub Railway-related facilities and facilitate passenger flow. Moreover, Phase VII will be constructed directly to the norht of Phase VI, and four sets of Island Platforms will be constructed for two new future Standard Railway Lines.

Phases VIII and IX will be on the ground level. Phase VIII will be located to the north of the Ground Concourse above the track intersection. A new Bus Terminus and a multi-storey car park will be constructed, with the Bus Terminal having a projected capacity of 100 bus routes. Nazca Railway will also be the main contractor for the construction and improvement works of the new roads. Finally, Phase IX will be located to the north of Phase VIII and will be an elevated structure on top of Prapiroon Road for future Local Rapid Transit use. More details of this plan will be highlighted at the Third Point.

2. Nazca Railway Headquarters Phase I: Station and Depot:

After years of preparations, the Nazca Railway Headquarters is finally ready to go to the stage of planning on paper. For the sake of convenience and contingency plans, the Headquarters will be built in different phases. The Headquarters will be located at the Centopia Area and Aurora Isles, and will be themed after the legend of Atlantis. Multiple Artificial islands will also be constructed for different uses.

Phase I of Nazca Railway Headquarters involve the construction of Centopia Station and the Main Nazca Railway Depot. Centopia will be a pill-shaped, north-south oriented island that will be 3km long. The elevated part, or the Daring Line, Local Rapid Transit Parts and the Concourse of the station, will first be constructed alongside the Depot and the vehicular access.

3. Establish Local Rapid Transits (LRTs):

After the Standard Railway and the Sub-Standard Railway, Nazca Railway will once again establish a new mode of transport known as the Local Rapid Transit (LRT). If the Standard Railway is considered a portion, the Sub-Standard Railway is considered three quarters, and the LRT will be half a portion, which is in turn more than the Light Railway, which is considered to be a quarter.

Unlike Sub-Standard Railways, LRTs run separately with the Standard Railway lines, and an area or a District will consist of several LRT Lines, with the code of such lines being an alphabet followed by a Number, say for instance Line A1. There will not be independent names on Local Rapid Transit Lines as the alphabet represents the code of the area. Moreover, the nubmer would not exist on its own either, as Veloducts use Alphabets as well. The Downtown, Shore Tip and Centopia Local Rapid Transit are currently under planning.

4. NR Station Tour Clips:

Exccept for the Station Introduction Videos filmed at the end of every episode, Nazca Railway also wants to introduce its stations properly. Besides of Metropolis Terminal, which will be filmed separately due to the scale of the station, the clips will be filmed in Chronological Order, and Spilt based on its Seasons and Episodes, depending on the time at which this station began services.

5. Full Implementation of the Nazca Railway Station Numbering and Directional System on all Standard Railway and Veloduct lines:

While this point does not have to be explicitly specified, it is nonetheless important. Since Season 3, Episode 7, the stations are now undergoing upgrades for its existing stations as Nazca Railway now has a complete study over the Station Numbering, and found a Numbering System fully fit for Nazca Railway. Besides of the Station Number, the Up Direction and Down Direction Stations will also be split clearly for the sake of Passengers.

6. NR Song Reaching 10'000 words:

This Target is a long-term Target. NR Song currently only has around 4'000 words. However, the word database will be extended. While this does not have practical applications, it is nonetheless an interest of mine.

Current Progress[]

  • The four Island Platforms proposed for Phase VII of Metropolis Terminal has been rescheduled for Phase VI and constructed for two new Standard Railway Strategic Lines, namely Pegasus Line and Phoenix Line.
  • While Centopia and Centopia Depot have already commenced services on July 8 2020, the former (Centopia) had undergone changes in plans during construction with the regards that all the Standard Railway and Veloduct Platforms, Elevated or underground, as well as the connecting taxi stations, have been built. However, the Part of the Local Rapid Transit Section and facilities have yet to be constructed.
  • The first Local Rapid Transit System (Shore Tip LRT) was confirmed to be built on August 23 2020.
  • The Nazca Railway Station Numbering and Directional System is completely implemented on all Nazca Railway Stations on June 19 2020.
  • As of January 12 2022, the NR Song already has 6452 words.[1]

title: Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline

The topic of this page is not "Nazca Railway 2021 Plans".

The Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline is a Development Plan proposed by Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division for Nazca Railway Development starting from 2021. It is announced on the Nazca Railway Facebook Page on April 23 2021.

Contents

  • 1 Development Plan Link
  • 2 Original Text (In Chinese)
  • 3 English Translation of Full Text
  • 4 Fun Facts
  • 5 Current Progress
    • 5.1 Within the Development Outline
    • 5.2 Other Contemporary Development
  • 6 References and External Links

Original Text (In Chinese)[]

洛聖加納鐵 Los Sengas NR

納斯卡鐵路洛聖加分部近月同多個地方嘅發展人員商討之後，納鐵決定未來將會推出一系列嘅新鐵路項目，以下係發展大綱。

甲：發展階段單位 Units of Development Milestone

洛聖加納鐵由第一日發展以嚟都係用「季 Season」、「集 Episode」同「章 Chapters」作為主要發展階段，間唔中喺兩集之間會有「外傳」。

納鐵會喺第 3 季完成之後，將會喺第 4 季開始嘅時候介紹「第 1 部 (Saga 1)」，小編之前講過，呢個只係開始。當然，每季仍然會保持著有 19 集唔多唔少。

乙：路綫延伸及新路綫計劃 Line Extensions and New Lines

納鐵已經同唔同嘅地方發展人員達成共識，將會喺唔同地方加入納鐵服務，興建新車站、路綫延伸同加入新路綫。可能又要需時幾年時間完成，不過未完成應該會又有新一疊項目等著開始㗎喇。

路綫延伸：

- 3 號大城綫 Urban Line 會向北延伸一個站，並喺「近北閘口站 Intus Aquilo Gateway」同「隆永頓站 Longwington Station」之間加一個站，配合 40 號新綫發展。

- 4 號新華綫 New Edward Line 西行會由「湃汸角站 Python Delta Station」延伸至「滄崖站 Le Monde Station」至霞英區。東行會延伸至糸彗區嘅東南面，同 22 號糸彗綫 Cometsilk Line 轉乘多一次。

- 5 號球場綫 Stadium Line 西行會由「近西閘口站 Intus Occident Gateway」延伸至啄木大陸嘅西岸，預計會有 6 個新車站。

- 5C 號杹政綫 Xofa Crescent 會重新定義服務定位，唔會再望著上行同 5 號球場綫 Stadium Line 進行第二次轉乘，而會改為一條由主綫向外延伸嘅支綫，並會改名叫 5A 號杹政綫 Xofa Line。未來會向南至霞英地區。

- 6 號群島綫 Arcgo Line 西行會由「單盛墟站 Dansein Market Station」繼續延伸至北單盛，中間會途經幾個新車站，包括一個新嘅閘口站。遠期發展會喺東北面延伸至「白海站 Arctic Sea Station」。

- 7 號森水綫 Luxter Line 東行會由「沙燕檢查站 Sand Martin Checkpoint」會繼續沿著育華區北岸延伸至「雛菊島站 Daisy Island Station」。

- 7A 號沙花綫 Sava Line 喺下行方向會由「蔎草灣站 Vanilla Bay Station」延伸多兩個車站，至「西灘站 West Shoal Station」，以西灘站為終點站。至於上行方向會由「馬力島站 Horsepower Island Station」延伸至新嘅「海平島站 Peacean Island Station」同合作鐵路同 8 號法瓶綫 Flask Line 轉乘。

- 8 號法瓶綫 Flask Line 嘅下行會由「冰川站 Glacier Station」延伸兩個站至「海平島站 Peacean Island Station」同 7A 號沙花綫轉乘。

- 9 號千宿綫 Kinight Line 會由「德利臺站 Darey Terrace Station」南延，會經過自由海峽進入霞英，中間會同 17 號綠洲灣綫 Oasis Bay Line、32 號明眸綫 Vision Line 同速管鐵路 Epilson Line 綫轉乘。

- 10 號盜鈴綫 Daring Line 兩邊都會有延綫計劃。北面會延伸至北單盛，南面會進入霞英區。

- 11 號微風綫 Zephyr Line 將會連接「優托站|優托 Centopia」，另外喺杹政會以西北為主要延伸方向，會同 12 號瀲灩綫 Sparkling Line 同 5 號球場綫 Stadium Line 轉乘。

- 12 號瀲灩綫 Sparkling Line 同微風綫一樣會去「優托站|優托 Centopia」，而喺杹政會以西行為主力運行方向。

- 13 號原生綫 Origin Line 由「沙燕檢查站 Sand Martin Checkpoint」東行至「雛菊島站 Daisy Island Station」，中間會經過銘弓河南面、火敬洲同沱瀧北等地方。

- 14 號彩藝綫 Minecraft Line 由「銀河站 Galactic River Station」南延同新綫轉乘。

- 15 號入雪綫 Ingress Line 會由「淒寒谷站 Chilly Canyon Station」北延至位於入雪嘅一個新嘅閘口站。

- 17 號綠洲灣綫 Oasis Bay Line 由木星區嘅「宏景灣站 Grandview Bay Station」開始，經過自由海峽群島之後會二十二大陸南面著陸，未來會進入霞英。

- 21 號星影綫 Stadow Line 南北面都會有延伸計劃。南面會沿著木星區嘅西岸南延；北面會由「群北洲站 Arcgo North Island Station」北延，進入天角區 (新區，現稱柯特詩)。

- 22 號糸彗綫 Cometsilk Line 將會圓環，亦會同 4 號新華綫 New Edward Line 同 Delta Line 綫嘅延轉乘多一次。

- 30 號明石綫 Akashi Line 會進行第三期走綫，由「湃汸角站 Python Delta Station」延伸至「滄崖站 Le Monde Station」同新嘅閘口站，之後定義為發展完成。

- 31 號明曦綫 Daybreaker Line 擬會繼續東延，進入綠洲區同其以東區域同其他路綫轉乘。

- 32 號明眸綫 Vision Line 會繼續發展，以二十二西南嘅新閘口站為終點站。

- Alpha 綫會當 Juliett Line 綫成立時會將上行終點站由「沙燕檢查站 Sand Martin Checkpoint」改回「護獸區站 Zootuary Station」。

- Bravo 綫上行將會由「德利臺站 Darey Terrace Station」延伸經「滄崖站 Le Monde Station」進入霞英。

- Charlie 綫上行會由「淒寒谷站 Chilly Canyon Station」擬經入雪嘅閘口站之後延伸「白海站 Arctic Sea Station」。

- Delta 綫下行向東會延伸一個站同 22 號糸彗綫 Cometsilk Line 再次轉乘。

- Epsilon 綫下行計劃會沿著 17 號綠洲灣綫 Oasis Bay Line 進入二十二大陸嘅南面，然後進入霞英。

- Fox 綫上行會由「沙燕檢查站 Sand Martin Checkpoint」向東延伸至「雛菊島站 Daisy Island Station」中間走綫可能會同 7 號森水綫同 13 號原生綫平行，暫時未落實最終途經走綫。

- Golf 綫上行會由「馬力島站 Horsepower Island Station」向西延，進入天角區(現稱柯特詩)、經過西城群島北面邊界進入啄木北面同單盛。

- Kilo 綫上行會由 「圓周湖站 Pi Lake Station」東北延至「雛菊島站 Daisy Island Station」

新路綫：

- 1 號西環綫 West Ring Line 將會成立一條新支綫叫做 1B 號烏托邦綫 Utopia Line，將會分兩期興建。第一期會由「渣華灘站 Java Beach Station」運行至「優托站|優托 Centopia」，第二期會延伸至「飛船島站 Airship Island Station」同西環綫轉乘。

- 16 號冰川綫 Glacier Line 會成立 16X 號冰川特快 Glacier Express，同冰川綫一樣來往「冰川站 Glacier Station」同「泠極站 Coopol Station」之間，中間只會停轉乘站，不過南面走綫就唔係全部同冰川綫平行，喺唔同嘅走綫之中會增設冰川綫/特快車廠。

- 成立 23 號瑩溢綫 Glinstrouß Line，主力服務單盛地區，首條走綫以東西向為主，會同 6 號群島綫 Arcgo Line 同 10 號盜鈴綫 Daring Line 轉乘。

- 成立 24 號望溢綫 Prospectious Line，同樣係位於啄木北面嘅新路綫，定位於一條輔助綫，初期會服務北單盛附近區域，同 6 號群島綫 Arcgo Line 同 23 號瑩溢綫 Glinstrouß Line 轉乘，未來會向西北方向「開荒」。

- 成立 25 號護雪綫 Asylum Line，以護雪區嘅東北半島為起始點，南下經過入雪嘅閘口站之後改向西北，同 6 號群島綫 Arcgo Line、26 號姬雪綫 Snowty Line 等現時路綫延綫同新路綫轉乘之後至「姬雪北站 Snowty North Station」同 16 號冰川綫 Glacier Line 轉乘，未來展望會繼續向西/西北延伸。

- 成立 26 號姬雪綫 Snowty Line，顧名思義，會服務入雪大陸姬雪區一帶，首段走綫為東西向，至「伍姬站 Quinty Station」為主站，東面延伸 5 至 6 個站同 6 號群島綫 Arcgo Line 接駁，遠期延伸至入雪嘅閘口站；西面會延伸至「近北閘口站 Intus Aquilo Gateway」。

- 成立 27 號飛馬綫 Pegasus Line 為第一條策略綫。現時規劃主要服務綠洲灣、三蹄、市中心、卡城西/北至後生。

- 成立 28 號鳳凰綫 Phoenix Line 為第二條策略綫。現時規劃主要服務沙花經三拉、市中心、卡城北、法瓶至守時，未來兩綫嘅兩邊都會繼續延伸，服務更多地區同接駁更多路綫。

- 成立 29 號石江綫 Rover Line，主要為東西向路綫，擬會途經入雪、冰川、「利濱站 Qoser Coast」、「上石江站 Upper Rover Station」至天角。

- 成立 33 號綫 (待命名)，為二十二大陸西南、杹政以南兩個新區：霞英區同籬英區而設嘅環狀綫。

- 成立 34 號泠極綫 Coopol Line。同 16 號冰川綫 Glacier Line 一樣屬於地區路綫，喺冰川綫嘅東面同佢造一條平行路綫，由北面嘅「泠極站 Coopol Station」開始南下至「入雪南站 Ingress South Station」甚至齒崖。

- 成立 35 號遊惑綫 Wanderer Line，為木星區南面嘅東西向路綫。會同 3 號大城綫 Urban Line 同 14 號彩藝綫 Minecraft Line 轉乘，會經過自由海峽大橋到西面嘅霞英區。

- 成立 36 號常弦綫 Everchord Line，繼 23 同 24 號喺啄北新綫嘅一條遠期規劃路綫，已經知會同 23 號瑩溢綫 Glinstrouß Line 喺轡巒彎以西轉乘兩次，然後向西行。

- 成立 40 號 環北綫 Aquiloring Line，一條位於環繞著近北島嘅陸地海岸嘅環狀綫，不過唔會進入「近北閘口站 Intus Aquilo Gateway」，但有多條路綫可以轉乘至該站。

- 成立 41 號凌山綫 Lingshan Line，一條小型嘅姬雪-近北區嘅聯絡綫，主要負責應付近北東面同姬雪西面嘅區內需求，整條走綫會位於姬雪綫嘅北面，東面終點站擬同 6 號群島綫轉乘。

- 速管鐵路會成立 Hotel 綫，以「優托站|優托 Centopia」為下行終點站，之後會向西行進入杹政區域。

- 速管鐵路會成立 Juliett 綫，以「沙燕檢查站 Sand Martin」為下行終點站，會向東/東南行服務育華同雲霄地區。

- 速管鐵路會成立 Lima 綫，將會係途經「大都會總站 Metropolis Terminal」嘅新路綫，現時服務洛聖加嘅北面。首要走綫為大都會總站、彌拉機場至「沙花岸站 Sava Coast Station」。

- 速管鐵路會成立 Mike 綫，支援姬雪綫嘅特快需求，首段走綫東至入雪嘅閘口站，西至「近北閘口站 Intus Aquilo Gateway」。

丙：新地區捷運系統 New Local Rapid Transit Systems

納鐵亦會計劃擴建同成立多個地區捷運，包括

- 尖岸地區捷運二期 Shore Tip LRT (ST) Phase II，會擴展版圖至內海東同銘弓河

- 六夜地區捷運二期 Sexterade LRT (SX) Phase II，會成立 3 條新綫並北延至算華

- 沙花地區捷運 Sava LRT (SA)，分三期

- 市中心地區捷運 Downtown LRT (DT)

- 總部地區捷運 Headquarters LRT (HQ)，優托，屬於總部發展長期規劃之一

- 杹政地區捷運 Xofa LRT (XO)，擬規劃，主要位於區域西部一帶

- 沱瀧地區捷運 Torrent LRT (TO)

- 啄木地區捷運 Peckern LRT (PK)

- 啄北地區捷運 Peckern North LRT (PN)

所以，有排我起呀……

English Translation of Full Text[]

Los Sengas NR

After repeated discussion with the developers of different areas, Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division has decided to launch a series of New Railway Projects, and the Following is the Development Outline:

Part A: Units of Development Milestone

Since Day 1, Development of Los Sengas Nazca Railway is divided into Seasons, Episodes and Chapters as the main unit of development, with an occasional spin-off between two different episodes.

After the completion of Season 3, Nazca Railway will introduce the Concept of Saga in Season 4, where Saga 1 will begin. Just as I have said, It's Only The Beginning. However, just be reminded that Each Season will still have 19 Episodes, no more, no less.

Part B: Line Extensions and New Lines

Nazca Railway has reached a concensus with different area developers to introduce Nazca Railway services to different areas by building new Stations, extending existing lines and establishing new lines. While these development may take a few years, it is likely that more will come before these are complete.

Line Extensions:

- Urban Line (Line 3) will extend to the north by one station, and add a station between Intus Aquilo Gateway and Longwington Station to complement the development of Line 40.

- New Edward Line (Line 4) will extend westwards from Python Delta Station to Le Monde Station before proceeding to Teraleros. It will also extend eastwards to the southeast of Cometsilk and interchange once again with Cometsilk Line (Line 22).

- Stadium Line (Line 5) will extend westwards from Intus Occident Gateway to the west coast of Peckern Continent, it is projected that this extension will feature six new stations.

- Xofa Crescent (Line 5C) will redefine its service plans. Instead of interchaing once again wtih Stadium Line, it would become a branch line spurring off the main line, and will be renamed Xofa Line (Line 5A). It will extend to Teraleros in the future.

- Arcgo Line (Line 6) will extend westwards from Dansein Market Station to North Dansein, going to several new stations, including a new Gateway, in the process. Long term development will see it extend northeast to Arctic Sea Station.

- Luxter Line (Line 7}} will extend eastwards from Sand Martin Checkpoint to Daisy Island Station along the north coast of Yowah.

- Sava Line (Line 7A) will extend in the down direction by two stations, from Vanilla Bay Station to |West Shoal Station, and use West Shoal Station as its Permanent Down Direction Terminus. For the Up Direciton, it will extend from Horsepower Island Station to the new Peacean Island Station, where it will interchange with Flask Line (Line 8) and a Co-Op Railway Line.

- Flask Line (Line 8) will extend in the down direction from Glacier Station to Peacean Island Station, where it will interchange with Sava Line (Line 7A).

- Kinight Line (Line 9) will extend to the South from Darey Terrace, and enter Teraleros through the Strait of Freedom. It will interchange with Oasis Bay Line (Line 17), Vision Line (Line 32) and Epsilon Line in the process.

- Daring Line (Line 10) has plans to extend in both directions. It will extend to North Dansein to the North and Teraleros to the South.

- Zephyr Line (Line 11) will connect to Centopia. Moreover, it will mainly extend Northwest within Xofa, and will interchange with Sparkling Line (Line 12) and Stadium Line (Line 5).

- Sparkling Line (Line 12) will also connect to Centopia alongside Zephyr Line, and it will mainly extend Westwards within Xofa.

- Origin Line (Line 13) will extend from Sand Martin Checkpoint to Daisy Island Station to the east, passing through the south of Bowplate River, Flamelute Island and Torrent North in the process.

- Minecraft Line (Line 14) will extend Southwards from Galactic River Station and interchange with new lines.

- Ingress Line (Line 15) will extend Northwards from Chilly Canyon Station to a new Gateway in Ingress.

- Oasis Bay Line (Line 17) will start from Grandview Bay Station in Jupiter, pass through the Archipelago at Strait of Freedom and land at the south of Twenty-Second Continent, entering Teraleros in the future.

- Stadow Line (Line 21) has plans to extend in both directions. It will extend along the west coast of Jupiter to the South, and extend from Arcgo North Island Station to Alicorn to the North[1].

- Cometsilk Line (Line 22) will form a complete loop, interchanging with New Edward Line (Line 4) and Delta Line once again in the process.

- Akashi Line (Line 30) will develop Phase 3, and extend from Python Delta Station to Le Monde Station and a new Gateway, by which time it will complete development.

- Daybreaker Line (Line 31) will continue eastwards into Oasis and other districts to the east to change with other lines.

- Vision Line (Line 32) will continue development and terminate at the new Gateway at the Southwest of Twenty-Second Continent.

- Once Juliett Line is established, the Up Direction Terminus of Alpha Line will regress from Sand Martin Checkpoint back to Zootuary Station.

- The Up Direction of Bravo Line will extend from Darey Terrace Station to Le Monde Station before enterin Teraleros.

- The Up Direction of Charlie Line will extend from Chilly Canyon Station to the proposed new Gateway in Ingress before extending to Arctic Sea Station.

- The Down Direction of Delta Line will extend one station to the east to interchange with Cometsilk Line once again.

- The Down Direction of Epsilon Line (Now named Echo Line) will extend to the South of Twenty-Second Continent along Oasis Bay Line before entering Teraleros.

- The Up Direction of Fox Line will extend from Sand Martin Checkpoint to Daisy Island Station to the east. While it may run in parallel with Luxter Line or Origin Line, the final route of this line that it will take is still unknown.

- The Up Direction of Golf Line will extend Westwards from Horsepower Island Station into Alicorn (Now named Odyssey), pass through the north edge of West Metropolis Archipelago, before entering Peckern North and North Dansein.

- The Up Direction of Kilo Line will extend Northwest from Pi Lake Station to Daisy Island Station.

New Lines:

- A new branch line of West Ring Line (Line 1) will be established, and is named Utopia Line (Line 1B). It will be built in two phases, Phase 1 will be between Java Beach Station and Centopia, whereas Phase 2 will see it extend to Airship Island Station and interchange with West Ring Line.

- An express line of Glacier Line (Line 16) will be established named Glacier Express (Line 16X). Like Glacier Line, it will run between Glacier Station and Coopol Station, stopping at only interchanges in the process. However, the south section would not run completely parallel with Glacier Line and would feature a new section, at which the Depot of Glacier Line and Glacier Express will be built.

- Glinstrouß Line (Line 23) will be established to serve the Dansein area. The first section of this line will run in an East-West Orientation and interchange with Arcgo Line (Line 6) and Daring Line (Line 10).

- Prospectious Line (Line 24) (Now named Prospektious Line) will be established. It is also a line serving the north of Peckern North and will act as an auxiliary line. It will initially serve the area of North Dansein and interchange with Arcgo Line (Line 6) and Glinstrouß Line (Line 23), and will extend to the northwest to serve new areas in the future.

- Asylum Line (Line 25) will be established and start at the northeast peninsula of Asylum. It will first travel to the south to the new Gateway in Ingress before turning Northwest, where it will interchange with extensions of existing lines such as Arcgo Line (Line 6) and Snowty Line (Line 26), before proceeding to Snowty North Station, where it will interchange with Glacier Line (Line 16). It is expected to further extend to the north or the northwest.

- Snowty Line (Line 26) will be established and, as its name suggests, will serve the district of Snowty within Ingress Continent. The first section of this line will travel in an east-west orientation, with Quinty Station being the main station. It will extend to the east by five to six stations and interchange with Arcgo Line (Line 6). Long Term development will see it extend to the new Gateway in Ingress to the east, and it will also extend to Intus Aquilo Gateway to the west.

- Pegasus Line (Line 27) will be established as the first Strategic Line, and is planned to serve Oasis Bay, TriPaw, Downtown, Northwest Katadelphia and Youngsters.

- Phoenix Line (Line 28) will be established as the second Strategic Line, and is planned to serve Sava, Threeler, Downtown, North Katadelphia and Punctual. Both lines will extend from both ends in the future to serve more areas and connect with more routes.

- Rover Line (Line 29) will be established. It will mainly be a route of east-west orientation, and will serve Ingress, Glacier, Qoser Coast Station, Upper Rover Station and Alicorn (Now named Odyssey).

- Line 33 (Now Named Tachyon Line) will be established as a new circular line at the Southwest of Twenty-Second Continent and the south of Xofa, mainly serving Teraleros and Poloros.

- Coopol Line (Line 34) will be established. It will also be a District Line like Glacier Line (Line 16) and will run parallel to it. It will start from Coopol Station and traverse sotuhwards to Ingress South Station and perhaps Tooth Cliff.

- Wanderer Line (Line 35) will be established. It will be an East-West Orientation line running within Jupiter, and will interchange with Urban Line (Line 3) and Minecraft Line (Line 14), before entering Teraleros to the west through The Great Liberty Bridge.

- Everchord Line (Line 36) will be established. It will be a long-term development line in Peckern North after Glinstrouß Line (Line 23) and Prospektious Line (Line 24). It is known that this line will interchange with Glinstrouß Line to the west of Bondhill Curves twice before proceeding west.

- Aquiloring Line (Line 40) (Now Named Aquilo Circuit) will be established. It is a circular line that will surround the coast around Intus Aquilo Island. While it would not enter Intus Aquilo Gateway, it will interchange with multiple lines that serves Intus Aquilo Gateway.

- Lingshan Line (Line 41) will be established as a small connection line between Snowty and Intus Aquilo in order to serve passengers at the east of Intus Aquilo and the west of Snowty. The entire line will run to the north of Snowty Line (Line 26) and will interchange with Arcgo Line (Line 6) at its east terminal.

- Hotel Line will be established for the Veloduct. Using Centopia as the permanent Down Direction Terminus, it will proceed west into Xofa.

- Juliett Line will be established for the Veloduct. Using Sand Martin Checkpoint as the Down Direction Terminus, it will proceed east, southeast and serve Yowah and Clouds.

- Lima Line will be established for the Veloduct that will pass through Metropolis Terminal. It will serve the north of Los Sengas. After passing through Metropolis Terminal and Mayler Airport, it will arrive at Sava Coast Station.

- Mike Line will be established for the Veloduct to act as the express service of Snowty Line. It will run between Intus Aquilo Gateway to the west and the new Gateway at Ingress to the east.

C: New Local Rapid Transit Systems

Nazca Railway also has plans to expand and establish multiple new Local Rapid Transits, including:

- Shore Tip LRT (ST) Phase II, it will extend to Internal Sea East and Bowplate River

- Sexterade LRT (SX) Phase II, three lines will be established for this LRT, and it will extend to Comp Ward.

- Sava LRT (SA), It will be built in three phases

- Downtown LRT (DT)

- Headquarters LRT (HQ), it will serve Centopia and is one of the long-term developments of the Nazca Railway Headquarters

- Xofa LRT (XO), it will mainly serve the west of Xofa.

- Torrent LRT (TO)

- Peckern LRT (PK)

- Peckern North LRT (PN)

Fun Facts[]

  • Line 24 in the Passage (Prospektious Line) was mistyped as Prospectius Line. However, on May 3 2021, one month after the release of this passage, it was modified into the original line name Prospectious Line. Subsequently, on Season 3, Episode 19, when this line was due to be established, the name of this line is once again modified to Prospektious Line to allude to the German-styled Glinstrouß Line.
  • From the Development Outline, it was seen that the original name of Aquilo Circuit was Aquiloring Line. It was not until February 3 2023 when the line changed its English Name.
  • While the name Tachyon Line was first seen at the Station Control Room of Markost Station on December 31 2021, the name was not officially confirmed as the line name of Line 33 until the construction of Ontario Sound Station.

Original Text (In Chinese)[]

Los Sengas NR 洛聖加納鐵

納斯卡鐵路即將踏入發展嘅第十個年頭，而家公佈來年，即係 2021 年嘅發展大綱。

總部第二階段： 優托車站、優托車廠同優托人工島已經喺今年 (2020) 年中完成建設，來年納鐵會繼續優托嘅建設，包括會喺島嶼嘅南北方設置多個停車場、喺車站嘅南面會興建酒店、車廠嘅東北同東南面新增 2 個公園、車廠東面會新增海濱長廊同商店街。另外，將會成立優托地區捷運，同 1B 號烏托邦綫(一期)連接二十二中部同優托。

成立策略綫系統： 大都會總站將會引入一對全新嘅路綫，項目總名「策略綫」，加強大都會總站同周邊地區嘅鐵路接駁。呢兩條路綫正式命名為 - 27 號飛馬綫 Pegasus Line - 28 號鳳凰綫 Phoenix Line 呢兩條路綫走綫會為呈「X」形，但喺大都會總站交會之外，喺市中心嘅東面同西面都會有跨月台轉乘同行車轉乘。預計初期投入服務時候受惠地區會有：市中心、沙花、卡城、後生、三蹄、綠洲灣、法瓶同守時。

重新繪製線上地圖路綫圖： 納鐵將於 2021 年喺駐服洛聖加嘅線上地圖標記重新繪製，以統一類別顯示納鐵嘅路綫同車站，取代現有以多個類別顯示單一路綫同車站。為未來加入其他鐵路喺線上地圖路綫圖鋪路。

第二階段標識更新： 實際上，呢項工作已經喺半年前開始，一直以緩慢速度更新指示板。而家納鐵正式將呢項工作納入來年處理嘅項目：第二階段標識更新包括更換所有閘機嘅抬頭恭祝用指示板同埋黑底路綫方向牌。

當然納鐵喺 2021 年會發展嘅地方唔會咁少，亦都會有機會變化，但係呢個列表係納鐵希望喺來年會做同埋完成嘅工作，令納鐵系統更加完整同統一。

English Translation of Full Text[]

Los Sengas NR

Nazca Railway will enter its tenth year of development, and now is the time to announce the development plans for the upcoming year, or the Nazca Railway 2021 Plans.

Headquarters Phase II:

Centopia Station, Centopia Depot and the Centopia Artificial Island have all completed construction in the middle of this year (2020), and the next year will see continued construction in Centopia, including multiple car-parks at both ends of the island, as well as a hotel at the south of the Station, two new parks to the northeast and southeast of the Depot, along with a new Promenade and a New Shopping Street. Moreover, the Centopia LRT system will be established alongside Utopia Line Phase I, which would connect the center of Twenty-Second Continent with Centopia

Establishing the Strategic Railway System:

A new pair of Railway Lines will be introduced to the Metropolis Terminal, and this project is known as the Strategic Lines. The aim of the Strategic Lines are to enhance the connectivity of Metropolis Terminal with its surrounding districts. The lines will be named: - Line 27: Pegasus Line, and - Line 28: Phoenix Line

The two lines will form a Cross-Shape, but besides of the Metropolis Terminal, two brand-new stations featuring cross-platform interchanges between these two lines will also be built to the West and East of Downtown.[1] The project initial service areas of the Strategic Lines include Downtown, Sava, Katadelphia, Youngsters, TriPaw, Oasis Bay, Flask and Punctual.

Redrawing Online Map Markers:

Nazca Railway will begin re-drawing all Online Map Markers starting from 2021, so that all Nazca Railway Lines and Stations will be classified into the same type instead of opening one type for each line and station. This can pave the way for installing markers for lines from Other Railway Operators onto the Online Map.

Completing Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works:

While this project has already commenced half a year ago, the replacement works of the signs have been fairly slow. However, starting from this year, Nazca Railway will increase the pace of the SignPicture Updating Works Phase II, including replacing the "Welcome Sign" above the entry gates and the Black Background Directional Signs.

While Nazca Railway would not only develop things from this list, and things on this list are also subject to changes, this list is nonetheless a wish from Nazca Railway in order to make Nazca Railway system more integrated and complete.

Current Progress[]

  • The following development have already been completed in the order of Development Chapters:
    • S3E14P1: Utopia Line Phase I (Java Beach to Centopia)
    • S3E16: Pegasus Line Phase I (Metropolis to Snipe Valley)
    • S3I5: Pegasus Line Phase I Extension (Snipe Valley to Smelting Bay)
    • S3E17: Pegasus Line Phase II (Metropolis to Peacean Island)
    • S3E18: Phoenix Line Phase I (Metropolis to Arrowhead)
    • S3I6: Pegasus Line Phase III (Smelting Bay to Black Tea Lake)
    • S3E19: Phoenix Line Phase II (Metropolis to Helios)
    • PS4P1: Utopia Line Phase II (Centopia to Airship Island)
    • S4E2: Phoenix Line Phase III (Helios to Fall Point)
  • Nazca Railway completed redrawing all Online Map markers on March 2 2022.
  • Nazca Railway copmleted Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works on October 16 2022.

Original Text (In Chinese)[]

洛聖加納鐵 Los Sengas NR

(少說話、多數事)

【納鐵 2022 下發展大綱】

2022 年預計將會係納斯卡鐵路完成洛聖加分部第 3 季嘅一年。

// 首先，納鐵由第 4 季開始唔會再公開以數字描述季度，取而代之嘅會係佢嘅發展代號，第 4 季嘅發展代號為：

- 納斯卡鐵路：四季之交 Nazca Railway: The Four Seasons

《納斯卡鐵路：四季之交》(或《四季之交 TFS》) 會為第 1 部 (Saga) 嘅首篇，第 1 部嘅全稱為

- 納斯卡鐵路與二十四寶座 Nazca Railway and the Twenty-four Thrones

(你哋可以略稱「廿四寶座」或者英文 "the 24 Thrones" 或者「G1」)

// 優托嘅建造計劃會由 2021 年計劃押後至今個下半年至 2023 年上半年左右，不過為確保計劃唔會變相終止，納鐵決定開始第 4 季之前必須完成優托島嘅設施，同埋完成所有總部其他人工島嶼嘅填海同埋道路網，包括優托島嘅南北公路出口接駁、各個島嶼嘅連接路同埋來往杹政嘅連接路。

// 第 3 季最後兩集嘅發展內容以下：

第 18 集：

納鐵將會成立 28 號鳳凰綫 Phoenix Line，先發展東面嘅上行走綫，確定途經現有嘅車站包括：

- 「青環站 Cyan Loop Station」、

- 「坪率站 Candor Plains Station」、

- 「瓶仄站 Fosina Station」、

- 「瓶北站 Flask North Station」、

- 「瓶東檢查站 Flask East Checkpoint」、

- 「矩時灣站 Rectime Bay Station」、

- 「暖山站 Warm Cairn Station」、

- 「釘灣檢查站 Nail Bight Checkpoint」同

- 「尖矢站 Arrowhead Station」。

第 19 集：

鳳凰綫發展西面下行走綫，確定途經現有嘅車站包括：

- 「誠摯灣站 Sincerity Cove Station」、

Epsilon Line 綫改叫 Echo Line 綫，

Fox Line 綫改叫 Foxtrot Line 綫。

// 拍攝納鐵頻道「車站遊覽」短片系列 (非 YouTube Shorts)。

// 持續發展工程包括：

- 豎立納鐵車站直幡、

- 為現有車站新增挑戰同

// 下一份大綱會係有關《四季之交》嘅發展略要。

English Translation of Full Text[]

Los Sengas NR

Nazca Railway 2022 Part 2 Development Plans

2022 is the year in which Nazca Railway is projected to complete Season 3 Development.

// First off, starting from Season 4, Nazca Railway will no longer use numbers to describe the Season of development. Instead, a code will be used to represent the season. The Development Code for Season 4 is:

- Nazca Railway: The Four Seasons

"Nazca Railway: The Four Seasons", also abbreviated as "The Four Seasons TFS", will be the first Season involved in Saga 1, which is named:

- Nazca Railway and the Twenty-four Thrones

(You may refer to Saga 1 as "The 24 Thrones" or Simply "G1".)

// The development of Centopia will be delayed from 2021 to the end of this year or the first half of 2023. However, in order to guarantee that the development will not be aborted, Nazca Railway has decided to complete all facilities on Centopia before starting Season 4, while copmleting the rest of the islands involved in the Headquarters, as well as the Road Connections, including the North and South Access to Centopia Island, Access Roads between different artificial islands, and the Access Road to Xofa.

// The Development in the Last two Episodes of Season 3 is as follows:

Episode 18:

Nazca Railway will establish Phoenix Line and develop the Up Direction Route at the east first. The stations involved includes:

- Cyan Loop Station,

- Candor Plains Station,

- Fosina Station,

- Flask North Station,

- Flask East Checkpoint,

- Rectime Bay Station,

- Warm Cairn Station,

- Nail Bight Checkpoint, and:

- Arrowhead Station.

Episode 19:

Phoenix Line will develop the Down Direction Route at the west. The known Stations include:

- Sincerity Cove Station,

- Bonyal Bay Station,

- Vayler North Station,

- The Three Pass Station, and:

- West Shoal Checkpoint.

// In order to make sure that Veloducts completely allude to the NATO Phonetic Alphabets, the following lines will be renamed:

- Epsilon Line will be renamed Echo Line, and

- Fox Line will be renamed Foxtrot Line

// Film the NR Station Tour Videos (NOT YouTube Shorts).

// Continuous Development Plans include:

- Erecting Station Banners,

- Add Station Gauntlets to Existing Stations, and:

- Overtake the N.R.L.S.H. Plan after creating the NR Dex for all existing stations.

// The Next Development Plan will be related to "The Four Seasons".

Current Progress[]

  • All NR Dex have been created on June 4 2022.
  • The Introduction of Season 3, Episode 18 was released on July 7 2022.[1]
  • The Introduction of Season 3, Episode 19 was released on December 14 2022.[2]
  • Epsilon Line is renamed Echo Line on March 28 2024.

title: Nazca Railway By-Laws
safeHtml:
"Nazca Railway By-laws" (English Version)

Extracted and revised from “Public Facilities Regulation in the Server,” 29th version on December 31st, 2024, effective on January 1st, 2025 Hong Kong time.

Contents

  • 1 A: Citation
  • 2 B: Interpretation
  • 3 C: General Regulations
  • 4 D: Passenger Behaviors
  • 5 E: Track and Railway Service
  • 6 F: Shop Borrowing and Service
  • 7 G: Inn Ownership
  • 8 H: Passenger Asset Migration
  • 9 I: Global Compliance Request
  • 10 J:
  • 11 Citations and References

A: Citation[]

  • These by-laws may be cited as the Nazca Railway By-laws or NR By-laws.
     

B: Interpretation[]

  • “station”: any structure with “Nazca Railway”, “NR”, “納斯卡鐵路” or “納鐵” marking with station name;
  • “premises”: any station structure stated above with “Nazca Railway”, “NR”, “納 斯卡鐵路”, “NR” etc.;
  • “platform (train)”: a platform with block of iron as the main texture, and/or color bar next to the track, handing board with number, line and directions in inverted trapezium next to, in front of or behind the track, yellow lines, automatic platform gates and/or platform screen doors at platform edge;
  • “track”: all rail tracks connected and extended from NR platform. Tracks behind the platform yellow lines, gates or screen doors are included; any structure next to the track such as emergency platform, railings, signs, lighting systems, pillars, internal/external tunnel walls etc.;
  • “train”: all passenger-minecarts within Minecraft NR track areas;
  • “sign”: all signage used within or for NR premises, including signs made from Minecraft wooden text signs, SignPicture mod signs, and item frames containing ImageOnMap plugin maps;
  • “passenger” excluding “self”: any person who are using train service within NR station, platform or track area;
  • “passenger” of “self”: Holder of a single or multiple Minecraft account(s) using single or multiple IP address(es) is considered as single passenger;
  • “personnel”: or refer as “staff”, all individuals work for NR or permitted by NR;
  • “shop”: or refer as “NR Shops” or “store”, means all shops within NR premises, labeled as “NR Shops” and a line of shop number;
  • “borrower”: all individuals who borrow NR shops;
  • “inn”: or refer as “NR Inns”, means the area of an array of rooms or buildings managed by NR, for passengers to stay in;
  • “resident”: passenger who owns a room/unit in an NR Inn

C: General Regulations[]

1. Must abide local server rules:

a. Los Sengas Division: The Ten General Rules of the Project Nazca Main Server;
b. Terracept Division: The Ten General Rules of the Project Nazca Archive Server;

2. No unauthorized action can be done within NR areas including railway premises, platforms and track areas etc. such as:

a. Adding, removing or attempting to add or remove any structure;
b. Placing liquid or fluid;
c. Extracting liquid or fluid from any NR non-designated vessel;
d. Littering;
e. Altering or attempting to alter any sign content;
f. Conducting trading operations and/or advertising;
g. Using Mounts;
h. Bringing Animals;
i. Equipping elytra;
j. Flying;
k. Using status potions;
l. Being invisible (including using spectator mode);
m. Placing or using boats;
n. Wearing Dragon Head;
o. Doing parkour;

D: Passenger Behaviors[]

3. Do comply all instructions from NR staff and signs in railway premises;
4. Do enter and exit the station via designated entrances;
5. Do enter and exit the station entry gate areas via designated gates;

a. This by-law does not apply when gate area is not enclosed;

6. Do set and use personal teleport service without permission ONLY at designated NR Inter-station Teleportation spot;

a. Do not use any Worldedit teleport commands inside NR station, platform or track areas; or accessing or leaving NR station, platform or track areas;

7. Do queue up for using elevators and short range teleporters;
8. Do not use any NR devices or enter staff only area unless they are opened publicly;

a. It is allowed to enter stations and its areas which is under construction without permission when at least one exit is clearly defined, but interfering construction in any way is not allowed;

9. Do not add, block or interfere any lighting or sign system;
10. Rules for automated permission of NR sign usage at non-NR premises by third party:

a. Under the rules of local server, if passenger is allowed to use creative mode, they are allowed to copy any sign at NR premises;
b. Do not handhold any sign containing SignPicture mod signs unless copying or placing them;
c. Do not jettison SignPicture mod signs at NR premises unless the passenger has a clear intention to transfer the sign to one another, if the receiver failed to pick up, the giver should retrieve the sign at once;
d. Displaying NR signs at non-NR premises should only be used for vicinity location acknowledgement and directional guidance; collection or related purposes are not allowed;
e. Storing NR signs inside a container at non-NR premises is allowed;
f. Do not download any NR SignPicture mod sign via any method except using the mod itself;
g. Do not modify any NR sign, especially SignPicture mod signs;
h. NR is not responsible for notifying of any sign content change maybe due to link removal or update which are at outside NR premises;
 

11. Do not obstruct, flutter or insult other passengers from using any NR service;

a. Do not carry Worldedit //regen operation within 16 meters from any NR premises or track areas, regardless the height/depth or user’s identity;

12. Do not use any noise-emitting device such as note block within railway premises in any mean unless approved;

E: Track and Railway Service[]

13. Please use owned minecart, or claim a minecart from a designated minecart claim area;
14. Station passengers must board or alight via platform;
15. NR strongly suggests using depart routine for multiple departures;
16. Do not control any provided platform screen door or automatic platform gate while not departing from that platform;
17. Passengers should be patient for the whole depart routine operation. Passengers can press the depart routine reset button below the depart routine button or leave the station manually if the waiting time is longer than usual.
18.  If either the depart routine button or the depart routine reset button does not work in a normal manner, please seek the person in charge of NR to handle;
19. Passengers should not trespass the yellow line or platform doors when “please stand back from xx” or “xx is/are closing” is announcing or platform lights are flashing;
20. Do not place trains in front of a moving train within platform passenger track zone;
21. Do not ride backwards;
22. Do not board, alight or teleport away (not in emergency) between stations or the train has not completely stopped;
23. Do not change speed (not in emergency) outside platform area;
24. Passengers must not flutter other individuals and vice versa;
25. Unless specified in emergency platforms or special signs, track areas are only for passenger trains;
26. Emergency platforms are only for passengers who encounter an accident;
27. Passengers who encounter an accident between stations, are allowed to place trains and continue the journey when the situation is safe, or seek assistance from NR staff;
28. Mounts are not allowed in the track area;
29. No-fly zone within 15 meters above opened tracks;
30. Do not switch or alter any NR track and their automatic or manual switches;
31. Do not ride unopened sections. Whether passengers can ride a specific section can be decided by the following top-down hierarchy:

a. On-scene instruction from NR staff;
b. Platform information boards regarding the section (overhead board is not included);
c. NR official Facebook page or website press releases;
d. NR page or website system maps；

F: Shop Borrowing and Service[]

32. Passengers can request NR to borrow a non-borrowed/owned shop;

a. Requirements for applying themed shop:
ai. Borrowed no less than 2 regular NR Shops;
aii. Related business experience in server is a plus.

33. Passengers can only borrow one shop at a time;
34. Passengers can only borrow one shop per station;
35. Passengers can only borrow one shop after 10 days (from 7) from the last shop borrow-ship;
36. Passengers should complete setting up the previously applied shop before borrowing the new one;
37. All names and products from shops are not allowed to use existing names or nicknames other than the borrower. If more than one borrower using the same name or using exotic product names of the borrower are found, each side should raise evidence to claim ownership;

a. Los Sengas Division: Borrowers who owned permanent corporation are allowed to use their shop/product names;

38. Shop or product names are not allowed to use Nazca Railway related names such as “Nazca”, “納斯卡” etc. without approval no matter the names are claimed in other meanings;
39. Borrowers should only use Creative Mode within their shop area;
40. Unless specified, borrowers are allowed to change one-block layer of floor, wall and ceiling;
41. Borrowers are not allowed to add or remove any structure outside their shop area;
42. Borrowers are not allowed to remove or change the shop sign. The format of NR Shop signs are “XXX-YY”, where “XXX” is the station code and “YY” is the shop code;
43. Borrowers are allowed to place plaques at the top of the shop entrance;

G: Inn Ownership[]

44. Passengers can request NR to own a non-owned room/unit from an NR Inn;
45. Passengers can only own no more than two non-owned room/unit from an NR Inn;

a. Passengers can only own one NR Inn room/unit per NR Inn;
b. Passengers must apply for check-out of at least one NR Inn room/unit before requesting another NR Inn room/unit if their quota is full;

46. Passengers can request NR to own a non-owned parking space from an NR Inn;
47. Fresh residents have a priority to apply a parking space at the same inn, this right expires if the resident passes;
48. Unless specified, residents are allowed to change on-block layer of floor and ceiling, and any internal walls;
49. Residents are not allowed to add or remove any structure outside their room/unit area;
50. Residents are not allowed to remove or change the room/unit or parking space sign. The format of NR Inns room/unit signs are “XXX-YY”, where “XXX” is the inn code and “YY” is the room/unit code. The format of NR Inns parking space signs are “XXX-PYY”, where “XXX” is the inn code, “P” stands for Parking and “YY” is the parking space code.

H: Passenger Asset Migration[]

51. Passengers can apply for asset migration to let NR personnel update the assets for passengers with a number of conditions;

52. Only NR Shops and NR Inns can be applied for asset migration:

a. Passenger should list out all assets to be applied;

53. Passenger who applies for asset migration should only be changing of names, accounts transfer is not accepted:

a. One exemption is transferring assets from a hacked account. Passenger should proof ownerships of both accounts in order to be entertained;

54. After the application is accepted and handled, the passenger will receive a cooldown before next asset migration application, the cooldown calculation as follows:

a. A mandatory cooldown of 4 weeks,
b. Additional 1 week for each applied and handled asset,
c. This cooldown period does not affect other cooldowns;

I: Global Compliance Request[]

55. When “Test Stage” is in effect, please refrain from performing the following actions at the server until the “Test Stage” is announced over:

a. Teleporting by any means;
b. Operating Worldedit;
c. High-speed movement including but not limited to:
i. Riding trains;
ii. Riding horses (with or without customizations);
iii. Flying with elytra;
iv. Flying with Essentials “speed” command degree higher than 2 (sprint included).

The purpose of this measure is to ensure the server’s stability for allowing Nazca Railway to pass the Quality Assurance before opening a track section.

J:[]

The NR’s decision of Nazca Railway By-laws shall be final, any offenders may be prosecuted by NR or local server legal units.

Citations and References[]
